# Use Ubuntu 22.04 LTS as the base image, a common choice for cloud environments.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set a non-interactive frontend for package managers to avoid prompts during build.
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies for LAMMPS, and MPI.
# - build-essential, cmake, git: For compiling source code.
# - python3: (FIX) Required by the LAMMPS CMake build system.
# - ca-certificates: For secure git clone over HTTPS.
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: OpenMPI runtime and development libraries.
# - fftw3-dev: FFTW library, a common dependency for performance-critical packages like KSPACE.
# - libgomp1: GNU OpenMP library, explicitly requested.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    git \
    python3 \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    fftw3-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure OpenMPI for container environments.
# These settings allow MPI to run as the root user and specify the network
# interface, which is critical for multi-node communication in Kubernetes.
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT=1
ENV OMPI_ALLOW_RUN_AS_ROOT_CONFIRM=1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0
ENV OMPI_MCA_oob_tcp_if_include=eth0

# Set a temporary build directory.
WORKDIR /tmp/build

# Clone the latest stable branch of the LAMMPS source code from GitHub.
# --depth 1 creates a shallow clone, reducing download size.
RUN git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git

# Create a build directory and run CMake to configure the build.
# We enable specific packages required for this application:
# - BUILD_MPI=on: Enable MPI support.
# - PKG_REAXFF=on: Enable the ReaxFF package.
# - PKG_KSPACE=on: Enable the KSPACE package for long-range electrostatics (uses FFTW).
RUN cd lammps && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D BUILD_MPI=on \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on \
      -D PKG_KSPACE=on

# Compile LAMMPS using all available processor cores.
RUN cd lammps/build && \
    make -j$(nproc)

# Create the final application directory, copy required example files,
# copy the compiled executable to a system PATH location, and clean up sources.
RUN mkdir -p /app && \
    cp /tmp/build/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* /app/ && \
    cp /tmp/build/lammps/build/lmp /usr/local/bin/ && \
    rm -rf /tmp/build

# Set the application directory as the default working directory.
WORKDIR /app

# Set a default command to start a shell. This can be overridden at runtime.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
#
# MiniCluster Manifest for LAMMPS ReaxFF on Kubernetes with Flux Operator
#
# Environment: AWS CPU instance
# Application: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
#
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # Name of the MiniCluster for the LAMMPS experiment.
  name: lammps-reax-test
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster's Indexed Job.
  # Set to 1 to ensure the entire job runs on a single node.
  size: 1

  # Total number of MPI tasks for the job. Flux will run this many copies of the command.
  tasks: 1

  # When set to false, the job and pods are not deleted upon completion,
  # allowing for post-run inspection of logs and status.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Enforce strict schema validation for the MiniCluster spec.
    strict: true

  # Defines the container that runs the user's application.
  # There is only one container in this pod, running the LAMMPS workload.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The command to be executed by Flux. The operator wraps this with `flux run`.
      # This command runs a LAMMPS simulation using the reaxff potential
      # with specified variables for testing purposes.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # When false, this container is treated as a worker pod in the MiniCluster
      # and does not have extra privileges to launch jobs.
      launcher: false

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-test
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
  flux:
    arch: arm
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/flux-view-rocky:arm-9
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: hpc7g.16xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 64

context.details: Ensure all globbed files from examples/reaxff/HNS from the root of the lammps codebase are in the WORKDIR. Clone the latest branch of LAMMPS. You MUST put lmp on the PATH. You MUST install libgomp1.

context.optimize:
You MUST maximize the LAMMPS FOM, k-atom or m-atom steps per second. 
You MUST execute in the pwd with lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite      
You MUST choose instance type and resources that will maximize the FOM.
